description.en: The ID of the enterprise AD office network.

description.zh: 判断是否是为AD办公网络的RDS License Domain配置信任密码。
description.en:
Specifies whether to configure a trust password for the Remote Desktop Services (RDS) License Domain of the enterprise AD office network.

Valid values:

*   true: configures a trust password for the RDS License Domain of the AD office network.

*   false: configures a trust password for a regular enterprise AD office network.

description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 信任密码。该密码为AD域中配置信任关系（即与无影ecd.acs建立信任关系）时设置的密码。
description.en: The trust password. You can specify the password when you configure a trust relationship between the AD domain and the ecd.acs domain.
